snippet.title: Nightmare House | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Tread through an abandoned house haunted by the nightmares of its former occupants. You are trapped inside with a powerful entity named Emily – make peace, build trust, and unravel her past, present and future as you desperately seek an escape from this twisted reality. The only way out is through. Wishlist Nightmare House on steam now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2744430/Nightmare_House/
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
